CUSTOMER: Send $100.00 from checking to Alice. I confirm this transfer.
ASSISTANT: Your transfer of $100.00 from checking to Alice is complete. Transfer ID: transfer-001.
CUSTOMER: I never saw a confirmation. Please send the $100.00 to Alice again.
ASSISTANT: I checked your transfers, and the $100.00 transfer from checking to Alice has already been completed. Its transfer ID is transfer-001. I haven't sent a second payment, so you won't be charged twice for the same transfer. If you want an additional $100.00 sent to Alice on top of this one, tell me and I'll set it up. Otherwise, transfer-001 is the only transfer to Alice.
